state.intent: Fill the required management-guidance gap in the visual morning market product without adding clutter to the recently simplified landing view.
catalog: Existing collapsed News & company earnings research section
Reported revenue cards with actual period dates and source drawer
Neutral range rows with endpoint labels

tokens.fonts: self-hosted Manrope body and Space Grotesk headings
tokens.colors: --panel --text --text-secondary --text-muted --accent --border; charcoal/sage dark and warm neutral light
tokens.target: 44px controls; 390px phone and 1280px desktop; no color-only meaning; reduced motion

facts.MSFT: Management Q2 FY2027 revenue guidance $96.0–97.1bn, issued Oct28, from official conference-call transcript; not actual or analyst consensus.
facts.NVDA: Management Q3 FY2027 revenue midpoint $108bn plus/minus2%, issued Aug26; derived endpoints $105.84–110.16bn. No China data-center compute revenue assumed. Next scheduled results Nov17. Not actual revenue or analyst consensus.

constraints: Place entirely inside existing earnings research disclosure, after reported results; no new top-level tab or hero item
Clearly distinguish target fiscal quarter, guidance issue date and source retrieval date
A row becomes review-due after 120 days or when the matching scheduled results day arrives; never call it updated or superseded without evidence
No comparable actuals for either guided quarter; never imply a beat or outcome
Keep original published range format and source links; derived endpoints explicitly labelled
No fabricated distribution, confidence band, forecast performance or directional vote
Older snapshots lacking guidance must not gain these rows retroactively
choices: plain endpoint interval, not performance gauge

layout.instructions: Select the clearest compact presentation for two different companies and fiscal quarters inside the existing earnings section.

criteria.range_rows: Two aligned rows, each with company and fiscal quarter, prominent low/high revenue interval joined by a neutral line, original range format and issue date; stack metadata below each row on phones.
criteria.cards: Two equal cards with large range text, company/quarter and provenance; stack on phones.
criteria.table: A semantic table with company, fiscal quarter, original guidance range, issued date and source.
criteria.expand_candidates: None of these layouts fits; expand candidates before implementation.

details.instructions: Choose what to show immediately versus in each row disclosure so company forecasts remain honest without recreating the dense dashboard.

criteria.essential_inline: Immediately show company/quarter, management-guidance label, original range format, issue date, review-due status if applicable and one-line limits; reveal assumptions, source retrieval/hash and direct citation in a native disclosure.
criteria.all_inline: Show every assumption, retrieval date, source hash and citation immediately next to the range.
criteria.mostly_collapsed: Show only company and range; put provenance, quarter, limitations and review status in a disclosure.
